# DNS Blocking

> Public DNS blocklists and RPZ feeds for Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Unbound, NextDNS, and other DNS filtering setups.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/sparksbenjamin/DNS_Blocking

## What this project is

- A multi-output DNS blocking repository with standard hosts lists, exact-host security lists, RPZ files, and optional hardening layers.
- A one-stop source for phishing, malware, scam, tracking, adult, dating, social, streaming, gaming, DNS bypass, privacy, torrent, piracy, and similar DNS block categories.
- A generated repository with validation, source policies, and automated updates.
